title: Default-off gate MCP code-search merge shard tool
description:
Problem: `memorysmith_code_search_merge_shard` is implemented in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs` as an MCP-available write tool, but it is not part of the public MCP contract documented in `README.md`. The tool merges external shard databases into the main code-search index and is operationally specialized enough that exposing it by default increases accidental or unclear write surface area for normal MCP clients.

Desired outcome: keep shard-merge functionality available for explicit admin/indexing scenarios, but make it default-off at the MCP descriptor level so operators must opt in via `MemorySmith:Mcp:EnabledTools`.

Scope:
- In scope: mark the tool descriptor default-off for MCP, preserve explicit opt-in support through `EnabledTools`, and document the intended admin-only use.
- In scope: add focused tests covering `tools/list` visibility and explicit re-enable behavior.
- Out of scope: removing shard-merge implementation entirely or redesigning code-search index architecture.

Validation:
- Focused MCP/controller tests for disabled-by-default visibility and enabled override behavior.
- README or request-page note confirms the tool is internal/admin-oriented.

Confidence target: 90%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from MCP surface review after confirming `memorysmith_code_search_merge_shard` is a real MCP write tool in `ChatToolCatalog.cs` but is not part of the public README MCP table and should be default-off unless explicitly enabled.
